To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
EC-SOD protein and mRNA were found in macrophages, epithelial cells, and lymphoid tissue of the rat lung.
the EC-SOD gene is expressed in lung tissue and that the protein is localized in the plasma, on the epithelium, and on the surface of neutrophils and alveolar macrophages.
extracellular superoxide-dismutase, an enzyme that disposes reactive oxygen species, is localized in the lung in cells that are involved in the inflammatory process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of EC-SOD in the lung.
a possible role of the EC-SOD system in the defense mechanisms of the lung against inflammatory processes.
the distribution and regulation of extracellular super oxide dismutase (SOD) in the lung.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the distribution of EC- SOD mRNA and protein in the lungs of control rats and in rats with LPS- or hyperoxia-induced lung injury is not affected.
EC-SOD is synthesized in macrophage, neutrophils and epithelial cells of the bronchial and alveolar walls.
the EC-SOD is expressed in the lung tissue in the form of mRNA in macrophages, in the epithelium, and the arterial vessel walls.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EC-SOD is a protein that can be used for diagnostic purposes in inflammatory lung diseases.
EC-SOD is a key enzyme for lung defense against oxidative stress and inflammation.
neutrophils, macrophages, and the epithelium may serve as carriers of EC-SOD in lung tissue.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EC-SOD is expressed in lung macrophages, and in the epithelial cells lining the bronchus associated lymphoid tissue, and that the enzyme is released into the extracellular space.
neutrophils and alveolar macrophages are the carriers of EC-SOD in the lung and that the enzyme is not only expressed by epithelial cells.
EC-SOD can be used as a marker for activated macrophage and neutrophils.
